question: Kiran sells an object to Varun at a profit of 10%. Varun sells that object to Arun for ₹1,155 and makes a profit of 5%. At what cost did Kiran purchase the object?

Kiran sells an object to Varun at a profit of 10%. Varun sells that object to Arun for ₹1,155 and makes a profit of 5%.

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit Percentage / 100)
